verdict.rationale: stagewise is itself a standalone desktop agentic IDE with built-in agent chat sessions (docs-1, docs-19). Its context features include @mentioning files and browser tabs, slash commands typed in the chat, an auto-generated WORKSPACE.md, and clicking UI elements to attach them as context (docs-13, docs-15, docs-20, docs-10). Integration with other editors (gh-2, docs-26) covers only opening files and applying changes there, not chatting inside them. missing for 10: chat embedded in third-party IDEs like VS Code, independent hands-on corroboration of the in-IDE chat experience.
